info.title: bria/image-edit-increase-resolution
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "bria/image-edit-increase-resolution", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for Bria Increase Resolution API

desired_increase.description: Resolution multiplier to apply. Supported values are 2 and 4. Maximum output resolution is 8192x8192.

image.description: The image to upscale. Supported input types are Base64-encoded string or URL pointing to a publicly accessible image file. Accepted formats JPEG, JPG, PNG, WEBP.

preserve_alpha.description: Controls whether partially transparent areas from the input image are retained in the output.

sync.description: When false (default), the request is processed asynchronously. When true, the API holds the connection open until complete.

visual_input_content_moderation.description: When enabled, applies content moderation to input visual. Returns 422 if the image fails moderation.

visual_output_content_moderation.description: When enabled, applies content moderation to result visual. Returns 422 if the output fails moderation.

200.description: OK - the provider's native result document, returned unchanged. Comfy has not described this model's output yet, so neither its shape nor its media type is narrowed here; the provider's own documentation is authoritative.

schema.description: Comfy has not described this model's result document yet. Router returns the provider's native output unchanged, so the provider's own documentation is authoritative for the response shape.
